name: Scalar Queries
description: You are given an array $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$. All $$$a_i$$$ are pairwise distinct. Let's define function $$$f(l, r)$$$ as follows: let's define array $$$b_1, b_2, \dots, b_{r - l + 1}$$$, where $$$b_i = a_{l - 1 + i}$$$; sort array $$$b$$$ in increasing order; result of the function $$$f(l, r)$$$ is $$$\sum\limits_{i = 1}^{r - l + 1}{b_i \cdot i}$$$. Calculate $$$\left(\sum\limits_{1 \le l \le r \le n}{f(l, r)}\right) \mod (10^9+7)$$$, i.e. total sum of $$$f$$$ for all subsegments of $$$a$$$ modulo $$$10^9+7$$$.
input_specification: The first line contains one integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 5 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the length of array $$$a$$$. The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ ($$$1 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$, $$$a_i \neq a_j$$$ for $$$i \neq j$$$) — array $$$a$$$.
output_specification: Print one integer — the total sum of $$$f$$$ for all subsegments of $$$a$$$ modulo $$$10^9+7$$$
approach_summary: Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N using Fermat's Little Theorem (mod 10^9+7 or 998244353). Answer nCr queries in O(1) time per query.
